items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: And Miss Mack, and had another lady with her by the name of Mary Evans, and they did a number by the call of Bear. It was a beautiful thing, too, Bear. That was the name of her, Bear, but the way they sang it, huh?

ctx.x: No. What type of music did you play in the show, all sorts of?

Well, music for the chorus, the dance bar, and tap dance music, and music for the singer. Then the comedian named Henry Reno, he, you know, we should play some songs and things for him. And Billy Mack, well, he had all his own songs. Hard Luck was one of his songs. Yeah. Black But Sweet Old God. That's when you made a record. And Miss Mack, and had another lady with her by the name of Mary Evans, and they did a number by the call of Bear. It was a beautiful thing, too, Bear. That was the name of her, Bear, but…
